title: The Lost Cat
description: Mia looks for her cat Milo and finds him with some help.
instructions: Read about Mia and her cat. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🐱 Mia had a small grey cat called Milo. One Monday afternoon, Milo was not at home. Mia looked in the kitchen and under her bed, but she could not find him.
Mia was very worried. She went into the garden and called, 'Milo! Milo!' There was no answer.
Then she asked her neighbour, Mr Lee. 'Did you see a grey cat?' she said. 'No, sorry,' he said. 'But I can help you look.'
They walked down the street together. Some boys were playing football in the park. 'We saw a cat near the school,' they said.
🏫 Mia and Mr Lee ran to the school. Mia heard a small sound from a tree. Milo was in the tree! He was afraid and could not get down.
Mr Lee climbed a ladder and carried Milo down. Mia hugged her cat and said, 'Thank you!' That night, Milo slept on her bed.
